 Judgment

This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal arises against the judgment of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
III Court of Small Causes, Chennai, passed in M.C.O.P.No.1769 of 2014 on 06.01.2016.
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The claimant has filed this appeal seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. It is a case of the appellant/claimant that on 11.01.2014 at about 14.45 p.m., when the petitioner was crossing the road from West to East at Durgabai Deskmuh Salai, near MGR Janaki College,
Chennai, a motor cycle bearing registration No.TN-07-BU-5826 ridden by its rider in a very rash Pandian @ Pandi vs M.Joseph Raj on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31951999/
1 and negligent manner and endangering the public safety came from North to South, hit the petitioner.
Due to this impact, the petitioner sustained injuries.

Hence, the petitioner has filed a petition before the Tribunal claiming compensation in a sum of Rs.20,00,000/- from the respondents together with interests and costs for the injuries sustained by him.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.
Before the Tribunal, on behalf of the claimant, the claimant and two others were examined and six exhibits were marked.

On behalf of the respondent, the Insurance Company's Senior Assistant was examined as R.W.1.
5.

On appreciation of the materials before it, the Tribunal awarded compensation as follows:
(a)Compensation for Disability : Rs. 90,000/-
 (b)Loss of Income : Rs. 6,930/-

(c)Attender charges : Rs. 630/-
 (d)Transportation : Rs. 2,000/-
 (e)Extra Nourishment : Rs. 10,000/-
 (f)Damage to clothes : Rs. 1,000/-
( g)Medical

Expenses : Rs. 5,000/-
 (h)Pain and suffering : Rs. 30,000/-
 (i)Mental Shock and  agony : Rs. 10,000/-
 -----------------
 Rs.1,55,560/-
 -----------------
The said sum was directed to be paid by the second respondent along with interest at 7.5% per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit of the award amount.

6. Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant submits that though the Doctor has fixed the disability of the appellant/claimant at 90%, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Tribunal has erred in fixing the disability at 30%.
He also submits that the Tribunal erred in granting only a sum of Rs.2,000/- towards transportation and Rs.30,000/- towards pain and suffering, which is on the lower side.
7. I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant/claimant and have perused the records.

8. Considering the injuries sustained by the appellant/claimant, I am of the view that the compensation of Rs.30,000/- towards pain and suffering and Rs.2,000/- towards Transportation needs to be enhanced and the same is enhanced to Rs.40,000/- and Rs.5,000/- respectively.

Taking into account the nature of injuries sustained by the appellant and fixation of disability at 90% by the doctor, this Court fixes the disability at 60% and a sum of Rs.4,000/- per percentage of disability is awarded and accordingly, the award under the head disability would be Rs.2,40,000/- [4000*60%].

2
The award in respect of other heads is hereby confirmed.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 9.

In the light of the said discussions, the modified award amount is as follows:
 S.No. Particulars Award of   Tribunal   1. Disability Rs. 90,000/- Rs. 
 2. Loss of Income Rs. 6,930/- Rs.
3 . Attender charges Rs. 630/- Rs.
4. Transport to Hospital Rs. 2,000/- Rs.

5. Extra Nourishment Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 
 6. Damage to clothing Rs. 1,000/- Rs.

7 . Medical expenses Rs. 5,000/- Rs. 
 (Conservative  Treatment Charges)
 8. Pain and Suffering Rs. 30,000/- Rs. 
 9. Mental shock and agony Rs. 10,000/- Rs.
Total Rs. 1,55,560/- Rs.

10. Accordingly, the amount awarded by the Tribunal is enhanced from Rs.1,55,560/- to Rs.3,18,560/- together with interest at 7.5% per annum from the date of petition till date of deposit as compensation.
11.

The respondent/ Transport Corporation is directed to deposit the entire amount i.e.,
Rs.3,18,560/-, less the amount already paid, if any together with interest at 7.5% per annum from the date of petition till date of deposit and costs to the credit of MCOP.No.1769 of 2014 on the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, III Court of Small Causes, Chennai within a period of six(6) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
12.
